name: abaco-zuzzurellone
description: Abaco Zuzzurellone - static web game (web/) wrapped as an Android app with Capacitor

scripts.android:sync: npm run check && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease assembleRelease
